actual_prompt: Sci-fi concept art, cinematic digital painting: A relaxed programmer in a sleek black hoodie reclines in an ergonomic carbon-fiber chair, bare feet propped on a floating ottoman, sipping steaming coffee from a matte ceramic mug. Around them, translucent holographic screens drift mid-air—streaming cascading green-and-cyan code, interactive graphs, and 3D neural network visualizations. A slender, pearlescent humanoid AGI robot with soft bioluminescent joints types autonomously at a curved glass workstation. Background features glowing server racks with rhythmic amber-blue LEDs and a floor-to-ceiling panoramic window revealing a rain-slicked futuristic metropolis at dusk—neon-lit spires, aerial transit lanes, and hovering ad drones. Volumetric light rays pierce through misty twilight; shallow depth of field emphasizes screen glow on the programmer’s calm face. Ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, cinematic color grading.
